crew.name: Ronke
crew.tagline: A good arm. A better attitude.
crew.perk: No special combat quirk. Starts with Bleed.

crew.name: Hotshot
crew.perk: Always fires when a ball is ready, at twice the usual rate. Scattered aim; full movement speed while firing.

crew.name: Blue Monday
crew.tagline: Every bounce is a second chance.
crew.perk: Every bounce adds 5% damage. At the far wall, balls return through enemies to the player.

crew.name: The Whole Family
crew.perk: Each launch has a mirrored copy. Both deal half damage; a special reloads after both return.

crew.name: Professor Bonk
crew.perk: Automatically chooses upgrades and evolutions. Movement and aiming remain yours.

crew.name: Old Irons
crew.perk: Launched balls pierce enemies until they hit a wall.

crew.name: Nightshift
crew.perk: Fires from the far end of the pit. Base critical chance is 10%.

crew.name: The Wall
crew.perk: A frontal shield rebounds returning balls. Each shield bounce adds 100% of launch damage.

crew.name: Big Spender
crew.perk: Fires all ready equipped special balls together in a wide arc.

crew.name: Jinx
crew.tagline: Eyes on the ball. All of them.
crew.perk: Lobs balls over enemies to the aim point. They only collide after landing.

crew.name: Auntie Blue
crew.perk: No regular baby volley. Fires copies from a shared special-ball pool; effects can still create babies.

crew.name: Brother Bounce
crew.tagline: The floor is just another wall.
crew.perk: Balls bounce off the bottom edge. Catch or recall them to reload.

crew.name: King Again
crew.tagline: Rock bottom is a starting point.
crew.perk: No direct ball-hit damage or regular baby volley. Area and status damage are quadrupled; effects can still create babies.

crew.name: Dr. Orbit
crew.perk: Gravity pulls balls toward the far end of the pit.

crew.name: The General
crew.tagline: One move ahead of the mess.
crew.perk: Alternating turns: aim and fire your volley, then enemies act. Recall can end a long volley.

crew.name: Wild Thing
crew.perk: Automatically moves, dodges, aims, fires and selects upgrades.

crew.name: Birdwatch
crew.perk: Two falcons flying at the sides launch your balls.

crew.name: Last Call
crew.perk: Returning balls briefly orbit around you and hit nearby enemies.

crew.name: Digby
crew.tagline: There is always a deeper way.
crew.perk: Balls wrap between the top and bottom edges. Catch or recall them to reload.

crew.name: Softstep
crew.perk: Ordinary enemies cannot detect you. Guardians can; your health and damage are much lower.

crew.name: Grandpa Gold
crew.perk: Only two special-ball slots, with ten passive slots. No assigned starting special ball.

crew.name: Ball Boy
crew.perk: Ten special-ball slots, but no passive equipment slots.

crew.name: The Showman
crew.perk: Unavailable: the original character needs live Twitch audience voting. No offline substitute.
crew.disabled_reason: Requires live Twitch audience support; unavailable in this offline version.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.description: Applies two bleed stacks. Each later ball hit triggers bleed damage; maximum eight stacks.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Starts at 300% impact damage. Each enemy hit erodes damage by 40%, to a 50% minimum.

fire.name: Burn
fire.description: Adds a three-second burn stack, up to three stacks. Each stack deals fire damage over time.

frost.name: Freeze
frost.description: Has a 4% chance to freeze for five seconds. Frozen targets take 25% more damage.

brood.name: Brood Mother
brood.description: Each enemy hit has a 25% chance to spawn a baby ball.

laser.name: Laser (Vertical)
laser.description: On hit, damages all enemies in the same column.

laser_h.name: Laser (Horizontal)
laser_h.description: On hit, damages all enemies in the same row.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Applies poison for six seconds, stacking up to five times.

dark.name: Dark
dark.description: Deals triple impact damage and is destroyed on impact. Three-second cooldown.

iron.name: Iron
iron.description: Deals double impact damage but travels 40% slower.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.description: Each hit has a 4.5% chance to heal one health.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.description: On hit, lightning strikes up to three nearby enemies.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: Passes through enemies without bouncing off them.

earth.name: Earthquake
earth.description: On impact, damages a three-by-three-tile area.

light.name: Light
light.description: Blinds enemies for three seconds, reducing detection and giving their attacks a 50% miss chance.

wind.name: Wind
wind.description: Passes through enemies and slows them by 30% for five seconds. Impact damage is reduced by 25%.

charm.name: Charm
charm.description: Each hit has a 4% chance to charm for five seconds. Charmed enemies move upward and attack enemies.

egg.name: Egg Sac
egg.description: Breaks on an enemy into two to four baby balls. Three-second cooldown.

cell.name: Cell
cell.description: Splits into a clone on hit, twice per lineage.

time.name: Time
time.description: Impact leaves a freezing snare for 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds.

flesh.name: Flesh
flesh.description: Starts at half impact damage. Each bounce increases speed by 25%.

brimstone.name: Brimstone
brimstone.description: Nearby enemies receive burns and poison every second.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: An icy two-tile blast freezes for 0.8 seconds.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.description: Pulses damage across the field every 1.4 seconds.

toxic_sun.name: Legacy Toxic Sun
toxic_sun.description: Retired custom ball, retained only to display old expedition reports.

stormglass.name: Legacy Stormglass
stormglass.description: Retired custom ball, retained only to display old expedition reports.

eclipse.name: Legacy Eclipse
eclipse.description: Retired custom ball, retained only to display old expedition reports.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Pierces fronts; rear impacts gain 30% damage.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: A 30% hit chance causes six seconds of attacks on adjacent enemies.

black_hole.name: Black Hole
black_hole.description: Consumes one ordinary enemy, then disappears; seven-second reload.

flash.name: Flash
flash.description: Impact flashes and blinds the whole field.

freeze_ray.name: Freeze Ray
freeze_ray.description: A beam can freeze targets for ten seconds.

frozen_flame.name: Frozen Flame
frozen_flame.description: Stacking frostburn lasts twenty seconds and increases damage taken.

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.description: Drops freezing spikes along its path.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.description: Three bleed stacks; twelve stacks trigger a health-based burst.

holy_laser.name: Holy Laser
holy_laser.description: Strikes the target row and column.

incubus.name: Incubus
incubus.description: Can charm enemies; charmed enemies spread curses.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: Nearby enemies receive stacking burns each second.

laser_beam.name: Laser Beam
laser_beam.description: A blinding beam strikes along the launch orientation.

leech.name: Leech
leech.description: Attaches one leech that builds bleed over time.

lightning_rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning_rod.description: Implanted rods arc to nearby enemies every three seconds.

lovestruck.name: Lovestruck
lovestruck.description: Affected enemy attacks may heal you for twenty seconds.

maggot.name: Maggot
maggot.description: Infested enemies release babies when killed.

mosquito_king.name: Mosquito King
mosquito_king.description: Releases a seeking mosquito on impact; its kills heal.

mosquito_swarm.name: Mosquito Swarm
mosquito_swarm.description: Bursts into seeking mosquitoes, then disappears.

noxious.name: Noxious
noxious.description: Pierces while spreading poison to nearby enemies.

nuclear_bomb.name: Nuclear Bomb
nuclear_bomb.description: An explosive impact irradiates the whole field permanently.

nosferatu.name: Nosferatu
nosferatu.description: Bounces release bats that strike enemies and become Vampire Lord balls.

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.description: A curse bursts after five subsequent hits.

radiation_beam.name: Radiation Beam
radiation_beam.description: A beam applies stacking radiation vulnerability.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.description: Adds bleed and a five-hit curse.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.description: A piercing storm damages and blinds nearby enemies.

satan.name: Satan
satan.description: While flying, burns the field and drives enemies berserk.

shotgun.name: Shotgun
shotgun.description: Wall bounces eject fast, fragile iron pellets.

soul_sucker.name: Soul Sucker
soul_sucker.description: Pierces; once per enemy may steal health and weaken attacks.

spider_queen.name: Spider Queen
spider_queen.description: Hits have a 25% chance to release an Egg Sac.

storm.name: Storm
storm.description: Arcs at nearby enemies every second.

succubus.name: Succubus
succubus.description: Can charm for nine seconds; charmed hits heal.

sun.name: Sun
sun.description: While flying, blinds the field and adds burns each second.

swamp.name: Swamp
swamp.description: Leaves poisonous tar that strongly slows enemies.

vampire_lord.name: Vampire Lord
vampire_lord.description: Adds bleed; consumes ten stacks to heal.

virus.name: Virus
virus.description: Stacking disease can spread to nearby enemies.

voluptuous_egg_sac.name: Voluptuous Egg Sac
voluptuous_egg_sac.description: Bursts into two or three Egg Sacs.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.description: Pierces and briefly freezes every enemy it touches.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.description: Impact leaves a five-second damaging rockfall.

steel.name: Steel
steel.description: Starts slow and strong; impact damage grows with each hit.

banished_flame.name: Banished Flame
banished_flame.description: Darkflame stacks burst when they expire.

fireworks.name: Fireworks
fireworks.description: Bursts into seeking fireworks that apply burn.

laser_cutter.name: Laser Cutter
laser_cutter.description: Projects a continuous beam along its direction of travel.

timestop.name: Timestop
timestop.description: Launch freezes enemies and hostile shots for five seconds; thirty-second reload.

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.description: Pierces and deals extra damage based on current health.

warp.name: Warp
warp.description: Teleports after impact and gains speed.

time_bomb.name: Time Bomb
time_bomb.description: Drops delayed explosive snares along its path.

venom.name: Venom
venom.description: Applies stacking poison-like damage and a slow.

heart_swallower.name: Heart Swallower
heart_swallower.description: Once per enemy may steal health and weaken attacks.

reaper.name: Reaper
reaper.description: A 10% impact chance executes ordinary enemies and heals five.

x_ray.name: X Ray
x_ray.description: An X-shaped beam applies radiation vulnerability.

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.description: Launch curses the field; the curse bursts after six hits.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: Pierces and ejects piercing pellets on wall bounces.

petrify.name: Petrify
petrify.description: Launch petrifies enemies along its sightline.

tumor.name: Tumor
tumor.description: Infected ordinary enemies die after forty seconds.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.description: Infected enemies may return as allies after death.

offspring.name: Offspring
offspring.description: Clones on impact through four generations.

flesh_mound.name: Flesh Mound
flesh_mound.description: Emits a fleshy baby each second while flying.

lightning_bug.name: Lightning Bug
lightning_bug.description: Releases a seeking bug that arcs to nearby enemies.

mosquito_kingdom.name: Mosquito Kingdom
mosquito_kingdom.description: Releases stronger seeking mosquitoes; their kills heal two.

drill.name: Drill
drill.description: Pierces with extra impact damage until reaching the far wall.

armageddon.name: Armageddon
armageddon.description: Impact leaves a five-second meteor shower.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.description: Applies a random burn, slow, or freeze around an impact.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.description: Three growth stacks burst into a three-by-three tile blast.
